story.title: From partner farmers to the container
story.sub: Four stages that determine bean quality before it reaches your port.
stage.1.d: Vanilla flowers open for only one day, so farmers pollinate them by hand, one by one. Beans are harvested when ripe on the vine.
stage.2.d: Green beans are wilted, sweated, then sun-dried in stages over several weeks until they turn dark brown, supple, and fragrant.
stage.3.d: Beans are sorted by length, moisture, and aroma. Quality documents and test results are available on request for every lot.
stage.4.d: Beans are packed tightly, then export documents are prepared according to the requirements of the destination country.
